continuity.weather: clear; the last mist over the water and against the seaward side of the outer rocks; light breeze off the sea
continuity.notes: CONTINUOUS from 1B-15: Leaf launches first (Abby), then Charcoal (Remi) tears the cleared launch space (the launch scar mended in X19). Same sun as 1B (east, ~31 deg up). The flight line (1C-10/11) runs along the coast with Leaf behind and on the near (inland) side; screen direction L -> R held through 1E.

shots.staging: MEDIUM 50 mm air-to-air past the Santa Maria's mainmast: the camera ship flies ahead of Leaf on the inland side, looking back at Abby (left, face three-quarter); Leaf passes close beside the mast (10 m inland of it, just below the crow's nest). The LOOKOUT in the nest (beyond her, right) ducks as the wings sweep by, comes back up laughing and waves; Abby waves back with her LEFT hand (no attention drawn to it: a plain wave, her right stays on the grip). Line X4-01 (Abby), said as she turns back to the front.
shots.deviation: a slowed close pass (7 m/s) so one medium holds both; the laugh is a quick head bob (no laugh face in the humans library) + the sound; the crow's nest is set dressing (the ship model has none)
